As we were leaving the preserve, I noticed that he was taking a rock -- not a small stone, but more of a 3 lb. piece of quartz or something like that. He was being stealthy about it, carrying it alongside his body in such a way as to hide it from the caretaker of the preserve, who we passed on the way out, so he knew it wasn't something he should do openly. I told him that it was a preserve, and that he should be taking nothing out of it. He claimed he "wanted to study it." (No, he's not a geologist.)
